meta.title: A rainy school morning
meta.context: A Primary 1 learner is getting ready for a wet walk to school.
meta.concept: Use a familiar weather decision to connect the character with what rain changes in the day.

illustration.label: Rain clouds above a school path

sections.title: Look outside before school
sections.text: Dark clouds gather, and drops tap on the window. In Chinese, rain falling from the sky is 雨 (yǔ).

sections.title: Say what the weather is doing
sections.text: 下雨 (xià yǔ) means “to rain” or “be raining.” Example: 今天下雨。 (Jīntiān xià yǔ.) — It is raining today.

sections.title: A quick weather choice
sections.label: Tap to think
sections.prompt: What might you bring when 雨 begins?
sections.answer: An umbrella (雨伞, yǔsǎn) helps keep you dry on the walk.

sections.title: Quick recall
sections.answer: Rain. 下雨 (xià yǔ) means it is raining.

sections.title: Choose for the rainy walk
sections.question: It is 下雨 (xià yǔ). Which item helps keep you dry?

practice.prompt: Use your finger or stylus to write 雨. Compare its overall shape with the pale guide.

sources.title: 汉典: 雨 yǔ、yù
sources.note: Supports the reading yǔ, the meaning rain, and the example 下雨.
